description: This Java class defines a custom data type 'FloatDatatype' used within the OpenMRS project. It extends a serializing datatype class to handle serialization and deserialization of Float values, and is annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: FloatDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype for handling Float values in OpenMRS, providing serialization and deserialization logic.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Float object to its String representation; returns null if input is null.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a String to a Float object; returns null if the input string is empty.
